JointFinite.canonical_original_via_compo.declaration_and_body:
theorem JointFinite.canonical_original_via_component : Orthemology.Tranche20.OriginalBearerBridge.OriginalWitness
  JointFinite.framework JointFinite.B.x JointFinite.R.rg JointFinite.B.g :=
Exists.casesOn
  (Orthemology.Tranche20.OriginalBearerBridge.original_bearer_of_completion JointFinite.framework JointFinite.B.x
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun x =>
            x ∨
              JointFinite.B.x = JointFinite.B.l ∨
                JointFinite.B.x = JointFinite.B.r ∨
                  JointFinite.B.x = JointFinite.B.m ∨ JointFinite.B.x = JointFinite.B.z)
          (eq_self JointFinite.B.x)))
      (of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl Bool.true))))
    JointFinite.abc_full.completion JointFinite.abc_full.realisation JointFinite.abc_full.support)
  fun q h =>
